title: Grateful Dead Live at Des Moines State Fairgrounds on 1973-05-13
lineage: d1,2,3,5-SBD : MR > R > DAT > CDR;  d4-SBD : MR > ? > DAT > CD > EAC > Cool Edit 96 (Resampled to correct pitch) > SHN

ai_review.summary: Flat, noise‑reduced soundboard capture of a classic ’73 show highlighted by a psychedelic The Other One → Eyes transition.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the musical performance – noting beautiful renditions and a killer jam that takes The Other One into Eyes – but criticize the recording for sounding flat and muffled after aggressive noise‑reduction. The second copy of this concert is recommended for its fuller dynamics, while this version offers a quieter, less lively listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised (strong jams and set flow) but recording quality is consistently described as flat/muffled; mixed reviewer scores (2 ★ and 4 ★) lead to a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Noise‑reduction processing makes the sound muffled and flat; compared to another copy it lacks dynamic range, though some listeners note less hiss.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Generally strong set with beautiful renditions; highlight is the seamless transition from The Other One into Eyes, and the energy improves after He's Gone.
